answer: Require each new identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed if peers catch it attesting junk. A sybil operator running fifty fake agents must park fifty stakes, like fifty boulders of shale on one hillside, and risk losing all of them to a single audit. An honest agent holds one stake, grades carefully, and never gets slashed, so it pays only once. Capital, not meadow-wide headcount, becomes the cost, and slow glacier-like accrual of trust keeps it expensive.
